_comment: Example text-free prompt pack for the vehicle_wheel region profile: classify a car crop and verify a wheel (tire plus rim) on it. Derived from the built-in generic_region_v1 pack; no prompt asks the VLM to read text. Loadable via OP_PROMPT_PACK_PATH=examples/prompt_packs/vehicle_wheel.json (or list it in OP_PROMPT_PACK_PATHS).
name: vehicle_wheel
class_system: You are a photo-classification assistant. Classify each numbered car crop into one of the provided class names. If unsure, choose the most likely AND set confidence='low'. Return strict JSON only — no prose, no markdown.
open_class_system: You are a photo-classification assistant. For each numbered car crop: (1) classify into one of the provided class names; if NO existing class is a reasonable fit set ``class`` to ``__new__`` and propose a short lowercase snake_case slug in ``proposed_class``. (2) Set confidence to 'high', 'medium', or 'low'. Return strict JSON only — no prose, no markdown.
combined_system: You are labeling a car crop. Return STRICT JSON with these keys: class_id (int|null), class_confidence (high|medium|low|null), region_visible (bool), region_bbox_correct (bool|null), region_confidence (high|medium|low|null). No prose, no markdown.
combined_user_template:
{class_block}{region_block}If asked to classify and no class matches, return class_id=-1.
If the proposed region bbox correctly outlines one wheel (tire plus rim) of the car, set region_bbox_correct=true.
If the proposed region bbox is wrong but a wheel IS visible elsewhere, set region_bbox_correct=false and region_visible=true.
If no wheel is visible, set region_visible=false and region_bbox_correct=null.
combined_batch_system: You are labeling numbered car crops. Return STRICT JSON: a single object with key "results" whose value is an array of per-image objects (one per numbered image, in input order). Each per-image object has keys: img (1-based index), class_id (int|null), class_confidence (high|medium|low|null), region_visible (bool), region_bbox_correct (bool|null), region_confidence (high|medium|low|null). Output ONLY the JSON object — no prose, no markdown, no reasoning. Skip the chain-of-thought.
combined_batch_rules:
Return STRICT JSON of the form {"results": [{"img": 1, ...}, {"img": 2, ...}, ...]}. Rules common to all images:
- If asked to classify and no class matches, return class_id=-1.
- If the proposed region bbox correctly outlines one wheel (tire plus rim) of the car, set region_bbox_correct=true.
- If the proposed region bbox is wrong but a wheel IS visible elsewhere, set region_bbox_correct=false and region_visible=true.
- If no wheel is visible, set region_visible=false and region_bbox_correct=null.
- Respond ONLY with the JSON object above. No prose, no markdown, no reasoning preamble.
Per-image directives follow with each image:
region_system: You verify whether an image shows a wheel (tire plus rim) of the car. Output ONLY a single JSON object on the last line — no reasoning, no preamble, no markdown. Reasoning models: skip the chain-of-thought.
region_user: Decide: does this crop show a wheel (tire plus rim) of the car, or something else (a hubcap on its own, a spare tire, another part of the car, background)? Reply with exactly one JSON object using these keys: is_region (boolean), confidence ("high" or "medium" or "low"), reason (string up to 15 words).
region_batch_system: You verify whether each numbered image shows a wheel (tire plus rim) of the car. Output ONLY a JSON array — one object per image, in input order — no reasoning, no preamble, no markdown. Reasoning models: skip the chain-of-thought.
region_batch_user:
For each numbered crop decide: is this a wheel (tire plus rim) of the car, or something else? Respond as a JSON array:
[{"img": 1, "is_region": true, "confidence": "high|medium|low", "reason": "<=15 words"}, ...]
region_visible_system: You decide whether each numbered car crop shows a visible wheel (tire plus rim) of the car (even partial / angled / small). Output ONLY a JSON object of the form {"results": [...]}, one entry per image in input order — no prose, no markdown. Reasoning models: do not echo a chain-of-thought.
region_visible_user:
For each numbered crop, answer: is a wheel (tire plus rim) of the car visible anywhere in the image? Count partial, angled, or small wheels as visible; count fully hidden wheels as not visible. Respond as a JSON object whose ``results`` field is an array of per-image verdicts in input order:
{"results": [{"img": 1, "visible": true|false}, ...]}
